method: Direct inspection of decoded frames from unedited normal-camera raw captures, plus explicitly separate editor and installed-package environment fixture frames; exact source/build/input/telemetry retained separately
improved_boundary: Editor and installed-game fixture views show a weathered dark switch face with inset, fasteners, isolator grip, caution symbol and a small green safe/amber live lens. Existing power parameters affect the lens without recoloring the housing. Ordinary 720p approach frame 17 shows the dark face and green lens; the run does not operate power. The lower face is partly occluded by the player in the safe fixture view. The prior continuous ground-wetness repair remains visible. Whole-panel damage tint, abrupt dry-road boundary and surrounding material deficiencies remain.

major_defects.finding: Blue/yellow/red mannequin presentation, primitive infected body and block-like weapon remain in the focal encounter.
The service bay gains authored construction detail, but the approach remains a broad empty road with repeated facades and primitive interior structure; dense vertical industrial layers are absent.

Angular ground-wetness breaks and the flat green switch face are repaired locally. The abrupt rectangular dry-road transition, whole-panel damage tint and flat surrounding surfaces still fall below coherent scene material quality.

The approach column/header now carry visible dark-red tissue and vascular branches. Close views still read as smooth rubbery, repetitive lobes with luminous seams, and the surrounding arena has sparse organic coverage. This local improvement does not establish a convincing coherent invasion.
Two motivated warm task lamps now illuminate the panels, but clear daylight and exposed sky still lack the required cold storm atmosphere and coherent scene-wide lighting contrast.

unproven: Current package-09 720p ordinary input approaches the bay but records no power transition, panel event or electrical-floor damage; the 1080p run ends near entry. Package-04 ordinary consequence remains separately preserved. Package-09 fixture verifies native environment behavior but does not establish the full evolving player+rival+infected+arena composition. No natural arena_pressure transition is observed.
Interior, terrace and east-return beats were not reached before terminal state.
HUD occlusion during required later dense-combat states remains unqualified.
No final temporal-quality or raw audio qualification is claimed.
scope: Preserves accepted mechanics evidence; rejects current final visual quality. Does not reopen predecessor task acceptance.
service_bay_limit: Editor and installed-package automation position actors/camera and drive states. These frames validate the affected layer only; they are not a raw canonical-slice run or final acceptance.

service_bay_coordinate_defect.fix: Reflect Y and reverse polygon winding on the FBX export copy; preserve editable native coordinates and gameplay collision. Require imported minima, maxima and origin checks, not extents alone.

service_bay_editor_frames_scope: The current editor and installed-package environment fixtures validate switch material execution and native states only. Exact switch-assets-03 saved readback, switch-editor-02 Vulkan execution, runtime-09 package fixture and package-09 raw frames retain separate identities.
next_action: Replace the whole-panel damage tint with a localized physical material response driven by the existing damage presentation; preserve panel health, hit traces, collision and debris behavior, then validate damaged/destroyed states in the installed game.
